features.name: Scatter-scaled ceiling
features.description: 3, 4 or 5 scatters unlock up to 999x, 2,997x or 9,990x.

review:
Formula x10000 puts a crash-style racing bonus behind a classic 5x3, 10-line slot with motorsport symbols. Scatters are the gateway: three or more trigger the bonus, where you choose a racer and chase a growing multiplier.

The number of scatters sets the bonus ceiling: three allow up to 999x, four up to 2,997x and five up to 9,990x. The bonus can also be bought where permitted. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 10,490x maximum and a 96.1% RTP. It's the racing cousin of Always Up! x10000, and the interactive bonus makes it stand out from typical line slots.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
